multiplicity: Two-sided source/world paired t tests, Holm correction for exactly two primary contrasts. Report confidence intervals, every unit, and failure gates. Same-answer interchange invariance is a separate required diagnostic, not silently substituted into the primary contrast.

power.scope: Planning sensitivity under a normal source/world difference model, not a promise that the new world's variance matches old seeds.

compositional_floor_check.role: Report whether the fixed larger-model/noisy-second setting reaches this threshold. Do not tune or replace units based on compound outcomes.

world_replication: Each unit has its own corpus, support, validation, collision test, source initialization and fitting RNG. Independent random partitions of the previously untrained F17 system; overlaps across units are permitted, weights are never reused. This is replication across datasets in one new mathematical system, not 17 distinct algebraic systems.
test_policy: Finish every source, every first-operator arm, and every single-step robust-second candidate before opening any composite prediction. Composite labels enter only exact test construction and final evaluation. Select second candidate using known-step states/logits averaged over fixed validation noise levels; never use composite performance.
ending_rule: Run all 17 units and declared diagnostics regardless of results. Retain primitive failures. No new candidate, seed replacement, test-based hyperparameter tuning or early significant stopping. If the 40% floor check or same-answer stability check fails, report that requirement as unresolved.
scope: Confirm correct-correspondence functionality in a previously unexplored finite field with a fourfold-width model. Interchange tests downstream answer-information transport, not natural mathematics-specific encoding. Width, data coverage and world change together, so this is not a causal estimate of width alone. No equivalence claim from nonsignificance.
